title: Being locally of finite presentation is fppf local on the source
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that local finite presentation is fppf local on the source (statement lines 7027-7031). The proof checks the clauses of the chapter's general criterion for locality on the source: Zariski locality on source and target, preservation under composition, and the identification of the final descent clause with the algebra statement that flat finite presentation is permanent (proof lines 7033-7042). The level is H2: the verification is short but each clause is matched to its input rather than merely asserted.
